title: Baghdad Phantom: seven still images, then video in the government's first release

tellings.quote: George Knapp and I had reported on something called the Baghdad Phantom. We released seven images which were still shots

plain: A filmmaker, Jeremy Corbell, told podcast host Jesse Michels about an unexplained object over Baghdad, Iraq, that he calls the Baghdad Phantom. He says that he and TV journalist George Knapp first released seven still images of it, and that around three years later video of it appeared in the government's first official release of such footage. If true, it would mean the government confirmed something the two had already reported.
